title: Simple controls, clean photos, portrait
description: Strip the app down: bend and dither are each one switch plus three knobs, the VHS look is subtler, the camcorder overlay goes through the tape filter in the viewfinder but never into photos or videos, and the camera works in 4:3 portrait as well as landscape.

clauses.text: Bend has three knobs - NOISE, TEAR, COLOUR. All at zero leaves the picture alone; each one on its own changes the picture, and turning it further changes it more.
clauses.observable_by: tests named "bend knobs at zero leave the picture alone" and "each bend knob gets stronger as it turns" pass

clauses.text: Dither is one switch plus knobs for style, palette and pixel size, and every setting gives only palette colours (the full option ranges are v3 R4).
clauses.observable_by: a test named "dither knobs pick basic styles palettes and sizes" passes

clauses.text: Photos and video frames never contain the camcorder overlay, while the viewfinder shows the overlay run through the tape filter rather than drawn crisply on top.
clauses.observable_by: tests named "photos have no overlay" and "overlay goes through the tape filter" pass

clauses.text: Holding the phone upright gives a 3:4 portrait picture (240x320 for dithered square pixels; the analog camcorder shape is v3 R1) that is the right way up, and the date and time never overlap at any size or pixel shape.
clauses.observable_by: tests named "portrait frames are upright" and "date and time never overlap" pass

cases.description: for each knob alone, mean pixel difference from the input is >0 at 0.3 and larger at 1.0
knob ends are real choices, and a full pipeline frame at a spread of knob combinations stays in palette
a capture taken with the overlay showing equals the same frame rendered with no overlay at all, scaled up
with VHS on, most viewfinder pixels under the overlay are not the crisp overlay colours
portrait settings are 240x320; a sensor frame with a marker at its top-left, rotated 90, lands top-right of a 3:4 output; photo is 960x1280
at 320x240, 160x120, 128x112, 240x320, 64x48 and the analog 320x480 / 240x640 frames the date and time boxes do not intersect and stay inside the frame
